backend.otherPackages: unchanged packages reused Go cache where reported

covered: original query contract and path survive service reload
query authentication failure can resume with current original credential
only GET queries during recovery, no generation POST
simultaneous recovery calls claim one worker across database instances
late old worker progress, error and cleanup cannot overwrite new recovery
stale remote monitor snapshots cannot cancel new recovery
failed durable claim starts no worker
cached terminal SSE below claimed revision is ignored
persisted accepted videos are observed rather than submitted again
missing video observations preserve original ID
limitations: task query and download failures in browser validation use intercepted fixtures; they are not supplier availability guarantees
original acceptance metadata must have persisted and supplier task or artifact must still exist
video content quality and final revised movie remain outside this recovery verification
